notes.title: New version v 1.1 is live!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We are happy to announce the first big update to the game! Version 1.1 comes with numerous level design adjustments and minor graphic fixes, but most importantly, with a whole new map called 'Air Chamber 14' fully integrated into the storyline! The new map is now placed between what was previously level 3 and level4. 

The version also contains many fixes, regarding mispelled texts, wrong texts, and so on. Several parts of the in game messages have also been changed to make the storyline easier to understand.

Expect more updates! Enjoy :)

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26234263/40593ef495807032abcc8a78800411f03bd6d3cf.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch 1.01 notes - adjusted controlls
notes.notes: The controls and physics of the player's ship have been adjusted to allow for much better handling as several players have found it too difficult and a bit sluggish. Enjoy :)
